levels.description:
Increases the Spirit's PvE Damage Tolerance by 20% and PvP Damage Tolerance by 10% for 4s, and redirects damage taken each time the Spiritmaster is attacked, sharing <chat_combat>50%</> to the Spiritmaster and <chat_combat>50%</> to the Spirit.
This effect is applied to the summoned Spirit with the highest HP. If HP is equal, it will be applied to the closer target. Damage is only shared if the Spirit is within 25m.

Unaffected by cooldown increase effects.
